notes.title: Added New Maps and preparations for Zombie mode!
notes.notes:
We've added 6 new maps, 2 of which are disabled for further developments, we included them in this update to reduce future patch sizes of coming updates.

New maps to check out:
Rome
The Manor
Warehouse
The Hangar

Zombies is almost ready to release! Keep an eye out on the next couple of updates as we plan to set the Zombie mode live very soon!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/k6JDDbYuv9]Join the Lock In Discord[/url], coordinate with others and setup games for matches! There you'll learn how to play with others in regions around the world!

Hope to see you there, be ready to Lock In!

~ Z
